children: Lithuania’s economy expanded by 1.7% quarter-on-quarter in the second quarter of 2026, in line with preliminary estimates, rebounding from a 0.1% contraction in the previous quarter.
The recovery was driven by stronger activity across key sectors, particularly construction (6.1% vs -1.9% in Q1), manufacturing (3.6% vs -0.2%), and trade-related services (3.3% vs -1.4%).
Financial and insurance activities also accelerated (2.4% vs 1.2%), while real estate activity increased 1.7%, compared with 0.3% in Q1.
Information and communications activity was broadly flat (0.0% vs -0.4%), while agriculture, forestry and fishing contracted 0.6% after expanding 5.2% previously.
Year-on-year, GDP growth accelerated to 4.1% in Q2 from 2.5% in Q1, confirming flash estimates and marking the fastest pace of growth since the fourth quarter of 2024.

title: Lithuania Economy Accelerates in Q2
